subject: Vendor intake: Meridian Labs onboarding — PO number + spend silo mismatch
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@meridianlabs.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@meridianlabs.com
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Initial intake — PO number needed for onboarding

Hi David,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. Finance at Meridian is ready to complete onboarding; they asked us to confirm the Redwood PO number you'll be issuing so we can map invoices to the right spend silo. Right now they see two temporary tokens on our side and can't reconcile line items (we have separate SKUs for seats and usage).

Can you confirm:
- Will Redwood issue a single PO with line item breakdown, or two separate POs (seat vs usage)?
- Any spend cap we should expect while provisioning?

I can attach our vendor intake form and the CSV export of the line items if that helps.

Best,
Maya
Vendor Ops | Meridian Labs

---
Attachment stubs: meridian_vendor_form_blank.pdf, meridian_lineitems_export.csv

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@meridianlabs.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial intake — PO number needed for onboarding

Hi Maya — great to hear momentum is moving. A couple quick clarifications so we can avoid the temporary tokens causing an orphaned spend silo: 

1) Our procurement practice is to issue a single PO per account during onboarding with explicit line items. We prefer a single PO with separate line items for "Seat licenses" and "On-demand inference usage" so Finance can map to different GLs.
2) Default provisional spend cap for new onboarding is $15,000/mo until the first billing cycle completes; that can be raised with a signed commitment.

Monica — looping you in for the formal vendor intake and to confirm the PO issuance flow and timeline. Vanessa — can you advise if we need any special tax docs from Meridian?

Thanks,
David
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Maya Patel <maya.patel@meridianlabs.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial intake — PO number needed for onboarding

Hi team — thanks for the details. Maya, attached is our vendor intake template (fillable PDF) and a short checklist for procurement to avoid PO/lineitem drift:

- Completed vendor intake form (W9 / VAT if applicable)
- Line items CSV with SKU, unit price, qty, and GL mapping
- Expected monthly spend and any initial credit request

If you can return the filled form and the corrected CSV I will:
- Create the procurement record and request PO issuance (target T+2 business days once docs are complete)
- Set provisional spend cap to $15,000/mo in the onboarding ticket; please state if you require a higher cap now

Note: from past onboarding, when vendors provide separate invoiceable SKUs but the CSV groups them under a single product code, our ledger may create a temporary spend silo. To avoid that, ensure the CSV uses the distinct SKU values you want mapped to distinct GL buckets.

Monica
Sr. Procurement Ops | Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: redwood_vendor_intake_template.pdf, procurement_checklist.txt

Thanks Maya — received and everything looks good. Monica confirmed the intake; procurement issued PO #PO-2027-3317 today and created two explicit line items to match your SKUs:

- PO-2027-3317-1: ML-SEAT-v2 — Seat licenses — qty 20 — unit price $120 — GL 5201
- PO-2027-3317-2: ML-CPU-HR — On-demand usage — qty open — billed monthly — GL 5302

Provisional spend cap set to $15,000/mo. Monica, can you please open the ledger mapping ticket to ensure the billing system maps the two SKUs to the correct spend buckets (avoid temporary silo)? If procurement needs a payment term exception or to bump the cap, I'll handle the escalation.

Maya — you should see the PO in the vendor portal and a DocuSign link shortly.

David
